description: Start a proposal of a competition you sponsor: a draft of the proposal as written, funded from wallet. It mints the 16-byte competition id the escrow's addresses derive from and an internal draft competition (never listed until approved). Answers the proposal (201): its id, stage draft, the competition it composes, and next_steps. A draft may still fail its checks: proposal_checks runs them, proposal_update edits it. A competition you sponsor takes no entry from you (the entry check sponsor_self_entry). Signed in only, your own proposals: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401, and another account's proposal 404; an account with no linked Solana wallet is refused 403.

proposal.description: The SponsorProposal as you write it (JSON): version 1; competition {title, summary, description, rules, category, skills, duration_hours (how long entries stay open, in hours: 336 is two weeks)}, never a date: make.fun sets the opening, the deadline and the final window from duration_hours on every save and check, and replaces any you write; harness {template (a house scoring template: pumpfun-replay, solana-bars-1h, solana-clmm-lp; sponsor_templates lists the datasets, metrics, knobs and prize bar of each), dataset, metric, and its bounded knobs}, or, when no template fits, scoring {custom: {brief (what wins and how to judge it, in plain words), examples, kind?, runtimes?}} instead (it funds first: proposal_deposit once its checks but the template's pass, and the make.fun team sets up how it is scored while it is in review); a code bounty, judged on hidden tests make.fun writes, is always such a brief, with kind one of code-score, code-first, code-smallest, code-fastest, code-cheapest and its runtimes (sponsor_templates' code_brief says how to write it); submission_rule {max_per_day, max_total, strategy_note_required}; prizes [{place, amount_usd, title}] (placement prizes only, USD); optionally escrow {challenge_hours} (the escrow's challenge window, how long the posted result stays open to challenge before the winners can claim: whole hours, 24 to 720; leave escrow out for the house's 24 hours). The house fills the rest; a key it fills, or any upload, is refused

wallet.description: The wallet that funds and signs the deposit: one linked to your account (base58); default its first
